# Midway Comforts

Midway Comforts is a leading commercial HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) contractor based in Mumbai, India, founded in 1999 with over 26 years of industry experience.

## What We Do

We specialize in large-scale commercial and industrial HVAC projects — not small residential jobs. Our services include:

- **VRF (Variable Refrigerant Flow) system** design, supply, and installation
- **Central air conditioning** and chiller-based systems for large buildings
- **Ventilation systems** including AHUs, exhaust systems, and BMS integration
- **HVAC project management** — heat load calculation, system design, procurement, and site execution
- **Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)** and preventive servicing

## Industries We Serve

Hospitality (hotels, resorts), Healthcare (hospitals, clinics), Banking & Finance, IT & Corporate Offices, Educational Institutions, Retail (malls, showrooms, luxury brands).

## Notable Clients

Tanishq, Reliance Industries, HDFC Bank, Apollo Hospitals, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Sheraton (Colombo, Sri Lanka), Aero Mall (Pune Airport), Yashwant Rao Chavan Pratishthan, Country Club, and 100+ more across India.

Authorized dealer and installer for Toshiba VRF systems and Carrier air conditioning products in India.

## Service Area

Pan-India. International projects undertaken on a case-by-case basis (e.g., Sheraton Colombo, Sri Lanka).
